terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms of the timetable. Open a term to maintain its weekly classes.

anonymize.label: Anonymize {{name}}
anonymize.title: Anonymize {{name}}?
anonymize.description: Use this when a person asks to have their data erased. It cannot be undone.
anonymize.erases: The name becomes “Deleted person”; email, phone, birth date, notes and member number are erased.
anonymize.removes: Guardian links, class memberships, waiting lists and staff links are removed, bookings that lie ahead are canceled (a visit they cost comes back), and the account is deleted.
anonymize.keeps: Past bookings, passes and receipts stay as the school’s records.
anonymize.soleGuardian: {{name}} is the only guardian of a child. Link another guardian to the child, or remove the link, first.
anonymize.accountKept: Receipts, the audit log, announcements or duplicate decisions name the account of {{name}}, so it cannot be deleted. Disable the account instead.
anonymize.own: You cannot anonymize yourself. Ask someone else in the office.
anonymize.lastAdmin: {{name}} has the school’s last administrator account that can sign in. Make another account an administrator first; it counts once it is confirmed.
anonymize.adminOnly: {{name}} has an administrator account; only an administrator can anonymize them.

anonymized.title: Anonymized
anonymized.description: This person’s data was erased on {{date}}. The record stays only for the school’s history: past bookings, passes and receipts.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: The latest {{count}} recorded actions, newest first: sign-ins as someone else, mails queued again, merged duplicates, anonymized persons, accounts disabled, enabled, given another role or deleted, password-reset and setup links issued, and sessions ended. Events are kept for three years. Times are in the school’s time zone.
audit.noAccess: Only administrators can see this page.
